name: bfl-mcp
description: Black Forest Labs (FLUX) (builder tools): me, generate_image, generate_video. Every tool maps to a d

platform_mcp_bfl_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BFL_API_KEY
platform_mcp_bfl_api_key.description: BFL API key (bfl.ai dashboard > organisation > project > API keys), sent as the x-key header. Requests spend pay-as-you-go credits (1 credit = $0.01).

platform_mcp_bfl_webhook_url.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BFL_WEBHOOK_URL
platform_mcp_bfl_webhook_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL that BFL POSTs finished results to (webhook_url on every generation request); the way to receive results, since polling needs the per-task polling_url.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v1/credits -> {credits}: the remaining credit balance of the key's organisation (there is no user endpoint).

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: POST /v1/{model} (default flux-kontext-pro; also flux-kontext-max, flux-2-pro, flux-2-max, flux-2-flex, flux-pro-1.1, flux-pro-1.1-ultra …) with {prompt, input_image (URL or base64, for edits), seed, aspect_ratio (21:9…9:21)} -> {id, polling_url, cost}. Generation is asynchronous: the finished image URL (result.sample) is delivered to the configured webhook_url or read from raw.polling_url with the x-key header. FLUX.2 models size with width/height instead of aspect_ratio. negative_prompt and size are not sent.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: POST /v1/flux-3-video {mode: t2v, prompt, aspect_ratio (21:9, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16 … or auto), duration (5–20 s)} -> {id, polling_url}: text-to-video with native audio. Image-to-video (mode i2v) needs a keyframes array and is not mapped; image_url and model are not sent. Results are fetched from raw.polling_url: webhook_url is not sent, because every Flux 3 video input schema in https://api.bfl.ai/openapi.json (Flux3VideoT2VInputs …) forbids extra properties and has no webhook_url (FluxKontextProInputs, used by generate_image, does; auth audit 2026-09-26).
